vocabulary.message: Power Log couldn't open on your Apple Watch.
vocabulary.nextStep: Unlock your Apple Watch and keep it near your iPhone, then start again.

vocabulary.message: Power Log isn't installed on your Apple Watch.
vocabulary.nextStep: Install it from the Watch app on your iPhone, or turn off Use Watch.

vocabulary.message: Your Apple Watch didn't confirm the start.
vocabulary.nextStep: Open Power Log on your Apple Watch, keep it unlocked and nearby, then start again.

vocabulary.message: Your Apple Watch is still busy with another ride.
vocabulary.nextStep: Finish or discard it on your Apple Watch, then start again.

vocabulary.message: Power Log couldn't confirm the start.
vocabulary.nextStep: Start again.

vocabulary.message: This start was cancelled before the ride began.
vocabulary.nextStep: Start again.

vocabulary.message: This start arrived too late to begin the ride.
vocabulary.nextStep: Start again.

vocabulary.message: The ride didn't start.
vocabulary.nextStep: Start again.

vocabulary.message: Connect your bike to start.
Power Log is still checking your last ride.
vocabulary.nextStep: Open Power Log on the device that recorded it, then start again.

vocabulary.message: Power Log is still finishing your last ride.
vocabulary.nextStep: Wait a moment, then start again.

vocabulary.message: A ride is already in progress.
vocabulary.nextStep: Finish or discard it before starting another.

vocabulary.message: Another ride action is still running.
vocabulary.nextStep: Wait for it to finish.

vocabulary.message: Discard hasn't finished yet.
vocabulary.nextStep: Retry Discard.

vocabulary.message: This ride changed.
vocabulary.nextStep: Check the current ride, then try again.

vocabulary.message: This ride is being recorded somewhere else.
vocabulary.nextStep: Finish it where it is recording.

vocabulary.message: Finish needs your confirmation.
vocabulary.nextStep: Confirm Finish to end the ride.

vocabulary.message: This action isn't available right now.
vocabulary.nextStep: Check the current ride, then try again.

vocabulary.message: Your Apple Watch hasn't confirmed Finish yet.
vocabulary.nextStep: Keep it nearby. You can also finish on the Watch; your ride is kept.

vocabulary.message: Power Log couldn't confirm the recording.
vocabulary.nextStep: Open Power Log on the device that recorded the ride, then try again.

vocabulary.message: Recording was interrupted.
vocabulary.nextStep: Finish the retained recording or discard it.

vocabulary.message: The recording session ended unexpectedly.
vocabulary.nextStep: Finish or discard the ride to keep what was recorded.

vocabulary.message: This ride is still syncing between your watch and phone.
vocabulary.nextStep: Open Power Log on both, and keep them close together.

vocabulary.message: Watch data couldn't be synced.
vocabulary.nextStep: Finish without Watch data to keep the rest.

vocabulary.message: This ride needs attention.
vocabulary.nextStep: Tap Retry. Your recorded data is kept.

vocabulary.message: Power Log can't save to Health.
vocabulary.nextStep: Allow it in the Health app, or turn off Save to Health.

vocabulary.message: Health data is unavailable while this device is locked.
vocabulary.nextStep: Unlock it, then try again.

vocabulary.message: Power Log can't use Bluetooth.
vocabulary.nextStep: Allow Bluetooth for Power Log in Settings.

vocabulary.message: Power Log can't use your location.
vocabulary.nextStep: Allow location in Settings, or turn off GPS for this ride.

vocabulary.message: Your bike isn't connected.
vocabulary.nextStep: Turn on Bluetooth and the bike, keep it nearby, then try again.

vocabulary.message: Power Log is busy saving your ride.
vocabulary.nextStep: Try again in a moment.

vocabulary.message: This device is out of storage.
vocabulary.nextStep: Free up space, then try again.

vocabulary.message: Power Log couldn't save this change.
vocabulary.nextStep: Try again. Your recorded data is kept.

vocabulary.message: This ride was deleted.
vocabulary.nextStep: Choose another ride in History.

vocabulary.message: Something went wrong.
vocabulary.nextStep: Try again. Your recorded data is kept.
